study: ZTI-MCP R4 P1 targeted architecture and prior art
scope: Primary sources; documentary compatibility review, not implementation audit or novelty proof

sources.title: MCP Base Protocol
sources.status: Published MCP specification revision, not an IETF RFC
sources.supports: Per-request metadata; reserved prefixes; explicit application handles; error mappings; self-reported implementation metadata is not authenticated identity

sources.title: MCP Extensions Overview
sources.status: Official MCP extension guidance; does not establish ZTI-MCP membership or status
sources.supports: Owned reverse-DNS identifiers; per-request extension capabilities and server/discover; explicit opt-in; rejection when required extension unsupported; distinct Experimental/Beta/Stable process

sources.title: MCP Architecture
sources.supports: Host/client/server roles; context isolation; per-request capability negotiation

sources.title: MCP Transports Overview
sources.supports: Transport binding does not change protocol semantics; body metadata authoritative

sources.title: MCP Streamable HTTP
sources.supports: MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, and conditional Mcp-Name requirements; header-body agreement and HeaderMismatch; intermediaries do not infer policy safety from routing headers alone

sources.title: MCP Authorization
sources.status: Published MCP specification revision, referencing OAuth including drafts
sources.supports: HTTP OAuth access token audience and header requirements; stdio environment-credential distinction; access-token passthrough prohibited

sources.title: RFC 2606: Reserved Top Level DNS Names
sources.supports: example.org reserved for examples; org.example is illustrative reverse-DNS notation, not author-owned namespace

sources.title: SEP-2624 Pull Request and Commit History
sources.supports: Identifiable proposed revision and open status; no acceptance inferred

sources.title: MCP Interceptors Experimental Extension README
sources.status: Experimental, explicitly not accepted or official MCP extension
sources.supports: Status qualification only; implementation directories are not evidence of tested interoperability

sources.title: SEP-2624: Interceptors for Model Context Protocol, pinned proposal
sources.status: Draft SEP; Type Standards Track is MCP proposal type, not IETF RFC status
sources.supports: Validator/mutator lifecycle; receive validation precedes mutation; configurable audit/failOpen; mutation-chain atomicity differs from effect/registry atomicity
sources.limit: Read proposal text only; no repository implementation audit

sources.title: RFC 7515: JSON Web Signature (JWS)
sources.supports: Compact serialization, original encoded signing input, critical extension validation, ES256 example

sources.title: RFC 7518: JSON Web Algorithms (JWA)
sources.supports: ES256 uses P-256 and SHA-256; JWS signature fixed 64-octet R||S representation

sources.title: RFC 7519: JSON Web Token (JWT)
sources.supports: Registered claims, expiry/audience/jti semantics; private claims by agreement; profile restrictions may be stricter than generic JWT

sources.title: RFC 8725: JSON Web Token Best Current Practices
sources.status: Best Current Practice, BCP225; updates RFC7519
sources.supports: Controlled algorithm selection, issuer/audience validation, key lookup protection, explicit typing, mutually exclusive token-validation profiles

sources.title: RFC 8785: JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS)
sources.status: Informational, Independent Submission; not IETF Standards Track
sources.supports: I-JSON input restrictions, UTF-16 property sort, preserved Unicode, deterministic number serialization; plain sorted Python JSON is not general JCS

sources.title: RFC 9396: OAuth 2.0 Rich Authorization Requests
sources.supports: Structured authorization details and API-specific reduction/comparison; no generic JSON-subset permission proof

sources.title: RFC 8693: OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange
sources.supports: Subject/actor exchange; no automatic one-time input use or revocation linkage; nested past act claims informational for access decisions

sources.title: UCAN Specification
sources.date_note: No publication date inferred from live README
sources.status: Community specification, not an IETF RFC; main is mutable
sources.supports: Delegation/invocation distinction, attenuated authority, execution-time validation, current DAG-CBOR format; older JWT descriptions should not be applied unqualified

sources.title: Verifiable Intent Specification Overview
sources.date_note: Header date of draft, not independently inferred launch date
sources.status: Draft project specification; no IETF or MCP adoption inferred
sources.supports: Signed commercial mandates and SD-JWT layers; cumulative network budget already explicit; VI credential revocation deferred
